players.name: Daniel Jones
wk: Daniel Stephen Jones III, nicknamed "Danny Dimes" and "Indiana Jones", is an American professional football quarterback for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Duke Blue Devils and was selected sixth overall by the New York Giants in the 2019 NFL draft.

players.name: Tyler Warren
wk: Tyler William Warren is an American professional football tight end for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Penn State Nittany Lions, winning the John Mackey Award in 2024 prior to being selected by the Colts in the first round of the 2025 NFL draft.

players.name: Laquon Treadwell
wk: Laquon Malik Treadwell is an American professional football wide receiver for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ole Miss Rebels from 2013 to 2015, earning second-team All-American honors in 2015. He left as the school's all-time leader in receptions with 202 during the course of three seasons. Treadwell was selected by the Minnesota Vikings in the first round of the 2016 NFL draft. He has also been a member of the Atlanta Falcons, Jacksonville Jaguars, New England Patriots, Arizona Cardinals, Seattle Seahawks, and Baltimore Ravens.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
wk: Jonathan Taylor is an American professional football running back for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL).

players.name: Alec Pierce
wk: Alec Matthew Pierce is an American professional football wide receiver for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Cincinnati Bearcats before the Colts selected him in the second round of the 2022 NFL draft.

players.name: Mo Alie-Cox
wk: Mohamed Alie-Cox is an American professional football tight end for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college basketball at VCU. Despite not having played organized football since he was a freshman in high school, Alie-Cox signed as an undrafted free agent with the Colts in 2017, and played for the team for nine seasons.

players.name: Andrew Ogletree
wk: Andrew Ogletree is an American professional football tight end for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Findlay Oilers and Youngstown State Penguins.

players.name: Will Mallory
wk: William Mallory is an American professional football tight end for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Miami Hurricanes.

players.name: Ashton Dulin
wk: Ashton Dulin is an American professional football wide receiver and kickoff returner for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Malone Pioneers.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.col: Kentucky; New Mexico State; Butler University; Oklahoma
wk: Seth McGowan is an American professional football running back for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners, the New Mexico State Aggies, the Butler Grizzlies, and the Kentucky Wildcats. McGowan was selected by the Colts in the seventh round of the 2026 NFL draft.

players.name: Pharaoh Brown
wk: Pharaoh Brown is an American professional football tight end for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He was signed by the Oakland Raiders as an undrafted free agent following the 2017 NFL draft. He played college football for the Oregon Ducks.

players.name: Anthony Gould
wk: Anthony Gould is an American professional football wide receiver and return specialist for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oregon State Beavers and was selected by the Colts in the fifth round of the 2024 NFL draft.

players.name: Anthony Richardson
wk: Anthony Dashawn Richardson Sr. is an American professional football quarterback for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida Gators and was selected by the Colts fourth overall in the 2023 NFL draft.

players.name: Nick Westbrook-Ikhine
wk: Nicholas Westbrook, known professionally as Nick Westbrook-Ikhine eh-KEE-nay, or simply "NWI", is an American professional football wide receiver for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Indiana Hoosiers and signed with the Tennessee Titans as an undrafted free agent in 2020.

players.name: Quez Watkins
wk: Terrance "Quez" Watkins is an American professional football wide receiver for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Southern Miss Golden Eagles and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the sixth round of the 2020 NFL draft. He signed with Pittsburgh in 2024.

players.name: DJ Giddens
wk: DJ Giddens is an American professional football running back for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kansas State Wildcats and was selected by the Colts in the fifth round of the 2025 NFL draft.
